templates.title: Wetland or waterbody relationship: {feature_label}
templates.summary: Desktop screening identified a mapped relationship between the project geometry and {source_name}.
templates.details: The relationship type is {spatial_relationship}. The mapped source feature is {source_feature_label}; the project feature is {project_feature_label}. Measurements are screening-level and should be reviewed against the source layer and project assumptions.
templates.implication: This may require wetland or waterbody review, permitting coordination, design adjustment, or field verification before conclusions are finalized.

templates.title: Hydrography relationship: {feature_label}
templates.summary: Desktop screening identified a mapped stream, river, ditch, or hydrography relationship from {source_name}.
templates.details: The relationship type is {spatial_relationship}. The mapped source feature is {source_feature_label}; the project feature is {project_feature_label}. Measurements are screening-level and should be checked against current design assumptions.
templates.implication: A crossing may require bridge or culvert review, permitting coordination, and field verification. This is not a final determination of jurisdiction or design need.

templates.title: Land cover or disturbance context: {feature_label}
templates.summary: Desktop screening identified mapped land cover or disturbance context near the project geometry from {source_name}.
templates.details: The relationship type is {spatial_relationship}. This context may help reviewers distinguish existing disturbed areas from less disturbed or forested areas.
templates.implication: The reviewer should consider whether the mapped context affects impact description, field review needs, or design coordination. Desktop screening only.

templates.title: Soils context: {feature_label}
templates.summary: Desktop screening identified mapped soils context near the project geometry from {source_name}.
templates.details: The relationship type is {spatial_relationship}. Soil attributes may include hydric soil, drainage, farmland, or other planning constraints depending on the source layer.
templates.implication: Soil context should be reviewed as screening-level information and may require coordination or field verification where it affects design or permitting assumptions.

templates.title: Species or critical habitat context: {feature_label}
templates.summary: Desktop screening identified mapped species or critical habitat context from {source_name}.
templates.details: The relationship type is {spatial_relationship}. The mapped source feature is {source_feature_label}; the project feature is {project_feature_label}. Critical habitat GIS is screening context and should be reviewed with IPaC and agency consultation material where applicable.
templates.implication: Protected species and critical habitat context may require reviewer confirmation, IPaC documentation, agency coordination, or field verification. This item does not establish a final species effect determination.

templates.title: Regulated facility context: {feature_label}
templates.summary: Desktop screening identified mapped regulated-facility context from {source_name}.
templates.details: The relationship type is {spatial_relationship}. The mapped source feature is {source_feature_label}.
templates.implication: Environmental due diligence or agency coordination may be needed. This screening item should be reviewed before it is used in report text.

templates.title: Cultural or historic resource review context: {feature_label}
templates.summary: Cultural or historic resource information requires reviewer attention for this project context.
templates.details: Available public or project-supplied data may be incomplete. Restricted cultural resource sources may not be present in the local workspace.
templates.implication: Qualified cultural or historic review may be required before report language is finalized. Restricted or sensitive datasets should be handled through approved workflows.

templates.title: Transportation or utility coordination context: {feature_label}
templates.summary: Desktop screening identified transportation, utility, corridor, or right-of-way context from {source_name}.
templates.details: The relationship type is {spatial_relationship}. The mapped source feature is {source_feature_label}.
templates.implication: Coordination may be needed with the relevant owner, operator, agency, or design lead. This is screening-level context only.

templates.title: Community or socioeconomic context: {feature_label}
templates.summary: Desktop screening identified mapped community or socioeconomic context from {source_name}.
templates.details: The relationship type is {spatial_relationship}. The mapped source feature is {source_feature_label}.
templates.implication: The reviewer should consider whether community resources, access, public services, or potential disruption require discussion or coordination.

templates.title: Parcel or property context: {feature_label}
templates.summary: Desktop screening identified parcel or property context from {source_name}.
templates.details: The relationship type is {spatial_relationship}. The mapped source feature is {source_feature_label}.
templates.implication: Property, parcel, ownership, or structure-age context should be reviewed before it is used in report text. Local source freshness may vary.

templates.title: Imagery or basemap review context: {feature_label}
templates.summary: Imagery or basemap context should be reviewed for conditions that may not appear in vector source layers.
templates.details: Imagery-observed features are review items, not authoritative facts. Source date, image quality, and positional accuracy should be considered.
templates.implication: Visible features may require reviewer confirmation, additional source checks, or field verification before report language is finalized.

templates.title: Flood hazard context: {feature_label}
templates.summary: Desktop screening identified flood hazard or floodplain context from {source_name}.
templates.details: The relationship type is {spatial_relationship}. The mapped source feature is {source_feature_label}.
templates.implication: Floodplain or floodway review may be needed where relevant, but this is a secondary screening category for the first implementation baseline.

templates.title: Source unavailable or deferred: {resource_category}
templates.summary: The {resource_category} source category is not ready for direct use in the current workspace.
templates.details: Current source status is {source_status}. The workflow should preserve this as a review item instead of blocking useful pre-review package generation.
templates.implication: Reviewer attention is required. The report should preserve uncertainty and avoid final conclusions for this category until source availability is resolved.

templates.title: No mapped relationship identified: {source_name}
templates.summary: No mapped spatial relationship was identified for {source_name} within the configured screening buffer.
templates.details: This means the analyzed local layer produced no mapped relationships in the current desktop check. It does not prove absence of field conditions or unmapped resources.
templates.implication: This item may support report drafting only after reviewer confirmation of source quality, source date, project extent, and screening assumptions.
